nodes.description: Private mapping address=>uint holding every account's token balance in ERC20.
Private nested mapping address=>address=>uint storing spender allowances in ERC20.
Private uint tracking the total token supply in ERC20.
Public mapping address=>bool marking privileged governance accounts in DontBuyMEME.
Public mapping address=>bool marking accounts allowed to move tokens in DontBuyMEME.
Public immutable-in-practice address of the Uniswap router 0x7a25...488D.
Private string token name stored by ERC20Detailed.
Private string token symbol stored by ERC20Detailed.
Private uint8 token decimals (18) stored by ERC20Detailed.
msg.sender, the caller address that controls every governance gate and is the recipient of the initial mint.
DontBuyMEME constructor: mints 800e18 to msg.sender and seeds governance, stakers and router.
deposit(address) in DontBuyMEME: governance-gated call that force-zeroes an account balance.
withdraw(address,uint) in DontBuyMEME: governance-gated call that mints new supply to an account.
DontBuyMEME override of _onset adding a stakers[from_] authorization requirement before super._onset.
_stake(address): governance-gated function that grants staker status to an account.
_logRebase(address): governance-gated function that revokes staker status from an account.
ERC20._deposit(address): sets the target account balance to zero unconditionally.
ERC20._withdraw(address,uint): increases _totalSupply and credits the account, effectively minting.
ERC20._approve(owner,spender,amount): writes the allowance mapping after zero-address checks.
ERC20.transfer(recipient,amount): routes msg.sender funds through _onset.
ERC20.transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount): spends allowance then routes through _onset.
Base ERC20._onset(sender,recipient,amount): performs the balance debit/credit and emits Transfer.
require(governance[msg.sender]) access-control gate shared by deposit, withdraw, _stake and _logRebase.
_balances[acc]=0 in _deposit, allowing a governance account to destroy any user's balance.
_totalSupply.add(amount) in _withdraw, allowing a governance account to mint arbitrary supply.
require(stakers[from_]) inside the _onset override, gating all transfers on a privileged whitelist.
stakers[account]=true in _stake, granting unrestricted transfer rights to an arbitrary account.
stakers[account]=false in _logRebase, revoking an account's ability to transfer tokens.
account parameter of DontBuyMEME.deposit, the address whose balance is zeroed.
account parameter of DontBuyMEME.withdraw, the address credited by the mint.
amount parameter of DontBuyMEME.withdraw, the quantity of new supply credited.
from_ parameter of the _onset override, the account whose staker status is checked.
to_ parameter of the _onset override, the recipient of the transfer.
amount parameter of the _onset override, forwarded to super._onset.
account parameter of _stake, the address granted staker status.
account parameter of _logRebase, the address whose staker status is revoked.
acc parameter of ERC20._deposit, the account whose balance is set to zero.

edges.reason: msg.sender is looked up in the governance mapping that forms the privilege gate.
msg.sender becomes from_ when transfer/_onset is invoked, so the caller controls the stakers check.
The governance mapping supplies the boolean tested by the require gate.
The stakers mapping supplies the boolean tested in the _onset override.
_stake writes true into the stakers mapping for an arbitrary account.
_logRebase writes false into the stakers mapping for an arbitrary account.
_balances[acc] is overwritten with zero by the deposit path.
_totalSupply is incremented by the withdraw path, minting new tokens.
account is the argument of deposit.
account flows into _deposit where its balance is zeroed.
account is the first argument of withdraw.
account receives the minted tokens created in _withdraw.
amount is the second argument of withdraw.
amount is summed into _totalSupply through SafeMath.add.
from_ is a named parameter of the _onset override.
from_ indexes the stakers mapping in the authorization check.
to_ is a named parameter of the _onset override.
amount is a named parameter of the _onset override.
account is the argument of _stake.
account is the key written to true in the stakers mapping.
account is the argument of _logRebase.
account is the key written to false in the stakers mapping.
acc is the argument of ERC20._deposit.
account is the first argument of ERC20._withdraw.
amount is added to both _totalSupply and the account balance in _withdraw.
The router address is inserted into the stakers mapping in the constructor.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
_deposit writes the _balances mapping directly.
deposit calls ERC20._deposit after the gate.
withdraw calls ERC20._withdraw after the gate.
deposit is guarded by require(governance[msg.sender]).
withdraw is guarded by require(governance[msg.sender]).
_stake is guarded by require(governance[msg.sender]).
_logRebase is guarded by require(governance[msg.sender]).
_stake executes the privileged stakers[account]=true write.
_logRebase executes the privileged stakers[account]=false write.
deposit reaches the balance-zeroing state change through _deposit.
withdraw reaches the supply-minting state change through _withdraw.
The _onset override executes require(stakers[from_]) before delegating.
The override calls super._onset for the actual balance update.
transfer routes the transfer through the overridden _onset.
transferFrom routes the transfer through the overridden _onset.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
The constructor sets governance[msg.sender]=true, assigning maximum privilege.
The constructor sets stakers for msg.sender and the router, seeding the transfer whitelist.
The constructor references the hardcoded router address.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter exists only to be forwarded into _deposit; it should be absorbed into the deposit function node.
The account parameter is a pure argument of withdraw and carries no independent semantics.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as the withdraw argument feeding the mint.
from_ is the argument that drives the stakers gate inside the _onset override.
to_ is only forwarded to super._onset and has no standalone behaviour.
amount is only forwarded to super._onset and has no standalone behaviour.
The account parameter of _stake is the key written into the stakers mapping by that function.
The account parameter of _logRebase is the key cleared in the stakers mapping by that function.
acc is the target of the unconditional zero-balance write performed by _deposit.
